description: Filter and opacity layers drawn as Chromium draws them (BLITZ-GAPS, fixed in the fork: filtered elements, drop-shadow() in currentColor, backdrop filters): drop-shadow() without a colour and with currentColor in the element's color; a filter applied to the element's outline and outer box shadow, and to content overflowing its border box; opacity applied to the outer box shadow and to overflowing content (toggled); a backdrop filter clipped to rounded corners over stripes. Every cell is a pixel region
